key_terms.جَنَّةِ: Garden/Paradise, referring to the eternal abode of bliss in the afterlife.

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about entering Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this divine address to the believer highlights the culmination of spiritual purification and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt, marking the transition from earthly trials to eternal proximity with God. It underscores the concept of 'Firdaws' as the highest level of Paradise, reserved for those who attain true gnosis (Ma'rifah) and piety.
